newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWIMMING-FOUR-YEAR DRUG BAN FOR SLOVAKIAN SWIMMER.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-FOUR-YEAR DRUG BAN FOR SLOVAKIAN SWIMMER.

text.p: Slovakian swimmer Frantisek Zahradnik has been suspended for four years after testing positive for anabolic steriods, the International Swimming Federation (FINA) said on Monday.
"He has been punished by the Slovakian federation according to FINA rules and has received the maximum four-year suspension," FINA executive director Cornel Marculescu said.
"There will not be an appeal because the time for that has passed."
Zahradnik, 27, a freestyle and butterfly swimmer, produced the positive result last September at a routine test during training at the Bonn swimming club where he was based.
He competed in the 1993 and 1995 European championships and the 1994 world championships but was not a finalist.
